en_title: PlayStation Killing Discs Has Upsides, Ubisoft Boss Yves Guillemot Says, Pointing to Cheaper Consoles Without Disc Drives
cn_title: 育碧CEO称PlayStation放弃光盘也有积极一面
subtitle: 纯数字主机有望降低售价

images.caption: 图片来源：Nathan Laine/彭博社 via Getty Images

paragraphs.en: Sony's controversial decision to kill PlayStation 5 discs could have some upsides, Ubisoft boss Yves Guillemot has said.
paragraphs.cn: 育碧掌门人伊夫·吉耶莫表示，索尼备受争议的PlayStation 5光盘淘汰决定，也可能带来一些积极影响。

paragraphs.en: Speaking yesterday during the company's most recent investor Q&A, Guillemot was asked by an analyst for his thoughts on Sony's bombshell announcement that it would discontinue discs for new PS5 games from January 2028 onwards, announced earlier this month.
paragraphs.cn: 在公司昨日举行的最新投资者问答会上，一名分析师询问吉耶莫如何看待索尼本月早些时候发布的重磅消息：从2028年1月起，新PS5游戏将停止推出光盘版。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps predictably, Guillemot did not strike too downbeat a tone in his answer — in contrast to the huge wave of negative backlash from fans that has been seen online, across social media, livestream comments and an enormous petition. Indeed, Guillemot suggested that some positives would come from the move.
paragraphs.cn: 或许并不意外，吉耶莫的回答并未显得过分悲观，这与网络上席卷社交媒体、直播评论区和大型请愿活动的粉丝负面反应形成鲜明对比。他甚至认为，这项转变会带来一些好处。

paragraphs.en: "What we saw on the PC is that it helped to grow the market," Guillemot noted. "There's also some pressure for the future on the cost of machines and being able to be only digital will help to have a more accessible machine, I would say."
paragraphs.cn: 吉耶莫指出：「我们在PC市场看到，数字化帮助市场实现了增长。未来硬件成本也面临一定压力，我认为只支持数字版，有助于推出价格更亲民的主机。」

paragraphs.en: Ultimately, Guillemot concluded that Sony's decision would likely not impact the wider industry too much — regardless of the passionate response by actual gamers, which Sony is seemingly doing its best job right now of ignoring.
paragraphs.cn: 吉耶莫最终认为，索尼的决定可能不会对整个行业造成太大影响——尽管真正的玩家反应强烈，而索尼眼下似乎正竭力对此视而不见。

paragraphs.en: "There are plus and minus," the Ubisoft CEO concluded, "but we think it will not disturb too much the industry."
paragraphs.cn: 这位育碧CEO总结道：「有利也有弊，但我们认为它不会给行业带来太大扰动。」

paragraphs.en: Guillemot's comments reflect the fact that the vast majority of game purchases are already digital, following the rise of downloads over the past decade. Indeed, Sony's rationale for ditching discs is that it's simply following consumer trends. "In response to shifting trends in consumer preference, new games will be released on PlayStation Store and at retailers in digital formats only," Sid Shuman, Senior Director, Sony Interactive Entertainment Content Communications, said in a post on PlayStation Blog , effectively telling gamers that this outcome was in a response to their own spending habits.
paragraphs.cn: 吉耶莫的说法反映了一个现实：随着下载版在过去十年崛起，绝大多数游戏购买行为已经转向数字渠道。索尼放弃光盘的理由也正是顺应消费者趋势。索尼互动娱乐内容传播高级总监Sid Shuman在PlayStation Blog文章中表示：「为回应消费者偏好的变化趋势，新游戏将只以数字形式在PlayStation Store和零售商渠道发行。」这实际上是在告诉玩家，眼下的结果源于他们自己的消费习惯。

paragraphs.en: "As consumer preferences and the broader entertainment industry continue to shift away from physical discs to digital, physical game disc production for all new games releasing on PlayStation consoles will be discontinued starting January 2028. Following this date, new games will be available on PlayStation Store and at retailers in digital formats only. This transition has no impact on games that already released, or will be releasing, prior to January 2028 in disc format.
paragraphs.cn: 「随着消费者偏好和整个娱乐行业持续从实体光盘转向数字形式，自2028年1月起，所有在PlayStation主机上推出的新游戏都将停止生产实体光盘。此日期之后，新游戏只会以数字形式在PlayStation Store和零售商渠道提供。这项转变不会影响已经发售，或将在2028年1月前以光盘形式发售的游戏。」

paragraphs.en: "This is a natural direction for Sony Interactive Entertainment to adapt to consumer trends as the general preference for digital media significantly outpaces physical discs. This transition will enable us to align more closely with how most of our community prefers to access and play games today."
paragraphs.cn: 「消费者对数字媒体的总体偏好已经显著超过实体光盘，因此这是索尼互动娱乐适应消费趋势的自然方向。这项转变将使我们更贴近当今社区中大多数玩家获取和游玩游戏的方式。」

paragraphs.en: Still, the online blowback to Sony's announcement has been huge, with the most vocal proponents of physical releases leading the charge, citing concerns over game ownership and preservation among the key issues. This week, a former God of War developer revealed that , and reportedly issued staff with the "strictest" social media guidelines to stop them from publicly commenting on the controversy.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管如此，索尼的公告仍在网上引发巨大反弹，最坚定的实体版支持者冲在最前，重点提出游戏所有权和保存问题。本周，一名前《战神》开发者透露[原文此处缺失内容]，而索尼据称还向员工下达了「最严格」的社交媒体准则，禁止他们公开评论这场争议。

paragraphs.en: But Sony seems unlikely to change course, and it has already begun reassigning staff involved with disc production. Cruically, Sony simply earns more money from digital games — at a time when consoles sales are being impacted by rising costs. For a first-party PlayStation game such as The Last of Us, Sony will only keep around 65% of the money from a physical copy, with around 30% going to the retailer and roughly another 5% on manufacturing costs. Meanwhile, for a physical copy of a third-party game such as the Activision-published Call of Duty, Sony will get a licensing fee, likely around 15%. For digital sales, Sony keeps 100% of first-party game revenue, and a far better cut from third-party titles.
paragraphs.cn: 但索尼似乎不太可能改变方向，并已开始重新安排参与光盘生产的员工。关键在于，当主机销量受到成本上涨影响时，索尼从数字游戏中赚到的钱确实更多。以《最后生还者》等PlayStation第一方游戏为例，实体版收入中索尼只能保留约65%，约30%归零售商，另有约5%用于制造成本。至于动视发行的《使命召唤》等第三方游戏实体版，索尼可能只获得约15%的授权费。数字销售中，索尼则能保留第一方游戏100%的收入，并从第三方作品中获得高得多的分成。

paragraphs.en: Like it or not — and many won't — financially it's hard to argue with Guillemot's assessment, even if it will likely only stir up more frustration among fans. Speaking to IGN, analysts have all said similar . Dr. Serkan Toto, CEO of Japanese game industry consultancy firm Kantan Games, suggested that even if half a million people cancelled their PlayStation Plus subscription in protest, it would be just a drop in the ocean for Sony.
paragraphs.cn: 无论大家是否接受——而许多人显然不会——从财务角度都很难反驳吉耶莫的判断，即使这番话很可能只会进一步激怒粉丝。接受IGN采访的分析师也都表达了类似观点。日本游戏行业咨询公司Kantan Games CEO Serkan Toto博士认为，即便有50万人为抗议而取消PlayStation Plus订阅，对索尼来说也只是沧海一粟。

paragraphs.en: "I sympathize with physical media fans, but Sony will not reverse this decision," Toto told IGN. "They of course knew what the online reaction would look like, and they now wait for this storm to pass.
paragraphs.cn: Toto告诉IGN：「我同情实体媒介爱好者，但索尼不会撤销这项决定。他们当然早已知道网络反应会是什么样子，现在只是在等这场风波过去。」

paragraphs.en: "Sony has over 120 million active PlayStation users," he continued. "Around 50 million people subscribe to PlayStation Plus. As a thought experiment, let's say 500,000 cancel in protest, that would be just 1% of that business gone — of course not enough for Sony to start rethinking. Digital is just too lucrative."
paragraphs.cn: 他继续说道：「索尼拥有超过1.2亿名PlayStation活跃用户，约有5,000万人订阅PlayStation Plus。假设有50万人为抗议而退订，那也只相当于这项业务流失1%，当然不足以让索尼重新考虑。数字业务实在太赚钱了。」

summary: 育碧CEO伊夫·吉耶莫认为，PlayStation停止为新游戏生产光盘虽有利弊，但纯数字主机可降低硬件成本并扩大市场。索尼数字销售分成远高于实体版，因此即使遭遇强烈抗议，也几乎没有改变决定的财务动机。
opus_summary: 实体版玩家强烈反对，育碧CEO却看到了更便宜主机的可能。对索尼而言，第一方数字游戏可保留全部收入，光盘版却要让出零售与制造成本，转向数字化的账很容易算。
